criteria: Coherence and originality 30% each. Craft and usability 20% each.
task: Select the oven order with the later start while having both bakes ready by noon. Reverse the selection and verify the alternative is still visible.
control: Same synthetic timings, initial choice, and locally embedded typefaces across all rounds.
scope: Independent live prototype review and isolated simulated browser viewports. Neither an installed-MCP change nor a native physical-device run.
authoring: Fixtures authored from the signed-off concept workshop. Critics used fresh tool-only sessions, blinded at each pair.
